parts.name: FieldRoot
parts.description: Groups a control with its label, description and error. It tracks the control’s state, validates it and writes that state as `data-*` attributes on every part.

props.name: name
props.description: The field’s name: the key of its value in a Form’s values and of its entry in a Form’s `errors`. The control takes it as its `name` when it has none.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Disables the field and its control. A disabled field isn’t validated.

props.name: validate
props.description: Custom validation, run after the control’s native constraints pass. Receives the value and the values of the form’s named fields; returns a message or a list of messages when invalid, and `null`, `""` or nothing when valid.

props.name: validationMode
props.description: When the field validates: `"onSubmit"` (when its Form is submitted, then on every change), `"onBlur"` or `"onChange"`. Whatever the mode, the browser checking the input (a native submit, its `invalid` event) validates it.

props.name: invalid
props.description: Marks the field invalid whatever its value, for a decision made elsewhere.

props.name: dirty
props.description: Controls the dirty state, instead of comparing the value with the first one.

props.name: touched
props.description: Controls the touched state, instead of tracking focus.

dataAttributes.name: data-dirty
dataAttributes.description: Present while the value differs from the one the control started with.

dataAttributes.name: data-disabled
dataAttributes.description: Present when the field is disabled, by its own prop or by a disabled Fieldset.

dataAttributes.name: data-filled
dataAttributes.description: Present while the field has a value: not empty, not unchecked, not an empty list.

dataAttributes.name: data-focused
dataAttributes.description: Present while the control has focus.

dataAttributes.name: data-invalid
dataAttributes.description: Present when the field is invalid: it failed validation, has `invalid` set, or has an error from its Form.

dataAttributes.name: data-touched
dataAttributes.description: Present once the control has been focused and left.

dataAttributes.name: data-valid
dataAttributes.description: Present when the field has been validated and passed.

parts.description: A native `<label>` whose `for` names the field’s control, so a press on it focuses or toggles the control. A group control (radio or checkbox group) is labelled by it through `aria-labelledby`.

parts.name: FieldError
parts.description: Shown while the field is invalid. Without children it shows the error: the browser’s message for a native constraint, or what `validate` returned, several as a list. With children it shows them instead. While it shows, the control’s `aria-describedby` lists it.

props.name: match
props.description: Shows the error only for one failure, named by a `ValidityState` key such as `"valueMissing"` or `"patternMismatch"` (`"customError"` for `validate`). `true` shows it always.

parts.name: FieldValidity
parts.description: Renders no element. Provides the field’s validity to its children as the `fieldValidity` context: the `ValidityState` flags with `valid` (null until validated), `errors`, `error`, `value` and `initialValue`.

parts.name: FieldControl
parts.description: A native `<input>` that is the field’s control. The same as Input; any `type` works.

props.name: value
props.description: The input’s value. Pass it with `onValueChange` to control the input.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: The value at first, when the input isn’t controlled. The first value is also the input’s `value` attribute: what a form reset puts back.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Called with the new value on every input, and once when a form reset changes an uncontrolled input.
